races.paceDynamic: Knockiel Synge, Keep On Dreaming, and Grange Soldier will ensure a genuine gallop from the start over this extended 3m½f trip on yielding ground. The three confirmed leaders will set a searching pace that will test stamina reserves, particularly with Grange Soldier prone to fading but likely to contribute early. This strong early gallop will stretch the field and create gaps, setting up the race for the hold-up horses to mount late challenges. The combination of genuine pace and stamina-sapping conditions clearly favours the hold-up merchants who can conserve energy early and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a strong gallop throughout the early stages
scenarios.body: The searching pace will stretch stamina and create the perfect setup for closers to pick off tired leaders in the final half-mile. Willitgoahead and Empire Soldier are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario with their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Turnupdevolume can track the pace without getting involved in early battles
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigner can use tactical speed to bridge between the leaders and hold-up horses, timing his challenge perfectly. His return from a long break could provide the freshness needed for a bold bid.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Keep On Dreaming or Knockiel Synge can dictate at a more controlled tempo
scenarios.body: One of the more reliable front-runners could steal a march if they manage the pace sensibly and see off their pace rivals early. Keep On Dreaming's recent form suggests he has the class to make all if conditions allow.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits All
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast too early and collapse dramatically
scenarios.body: A moderate pace scenario where the entire field stays in contention longer, allowing any horse with a turn of foot to strike. This would level the playing field but seems unlikely given the confirmed front-running styles.

races.paceDynamic: Laughing John will lead alone without pressure, setting a sustainable gallop that suits the 2m3½f trip perfectly. The real issue develops behind him where 11 runners want prominent positions - Daylatedollarshort, San Hilario, Judicial Deference, Krabat, Freshers Week and Onlymammycanloveme among them creating inevitable congestion. This bottleneck will form 2-3 furlongs out when the pace lifts, trapping several prominent runners and creating openings for patient hold-up horses like Matt Connor, Union Park and Moab. This pace shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the traffic and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates the expected traffic jam 2-3 out
scenarios.body: Matt Connor and Moab can use their patient styles to weave through and finish powerfully. The clean runs favour horses held back early rather than those stuck in the scrum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One escapes the pack
scenarios.trigger: If Daylatedollarshort or San Hilario break clear from the prominent group before the congestion hits
scenarios.body: Their superior ratings allow them to build enough lead to hold off late challengers. Fresh legs and tactical speed prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Laughing John stays solo
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader maintains his advantage throughout and the chasing pack neutralise each other
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead and Henderson's skill at placing front-runners pays off. The prominent horses spend too much energy fighting among themselves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent pace collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast trying to get position and come back dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Late runners get an armchair ride as the field comes back to them in the closing stages. Patient tactics are rewarded handsomely.

Matt Connor and Moab positioned perfectly as hold-up horses to exploit the anticipated pace collapse

races.paceDynamic: Touch Me Not, Full Of Life, and Jet To Monte Carlo will forge forward from the start, creating a relentless gallop over 2m½f that will stretch this big field from an early stage. The trio of confirmed front-runners means there's no question about pace - they'll drive each other along and ensure a truly-run race that will test stamina reserves to the maximum. With 21 runners spread across the course and that sustained tempo, the race will become a war of attrition in the final half-mile. This setup heavily favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can unleash late kicks when the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and crack approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will find out the leaders' stamina limitations, allowing patient hold-up horses with finishing kicks to sweep past tired rivals. Karbau and Lord Erskine are perfectly positioned to capitalise with their proven late-running styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Touch Me Not or Full Of Life can dictate fractions and kick clear when rivals expect them to weaken
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters will have judged the gallop perfectly and find extra when the field closes, benefiting from Willie Mullins' tactical expertise or Gordon Elliott's big-race know-how. Their rivals will be left chasing shadows up the hill.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If a horse positioned just behind the leaders can time their move perfectly at the second-last
scenarios.body: The middle-distance runners will benefit from a perfect stalking trip, close enough to strike but far enough back to conserve energy. They'll have the tactical edge when the pace collapses but before the back-markers can get organised.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so strong that even prominent runners are struggling, allowing a back-marker to produce a barnstorming finish
scenarios.body: The combination of 21 runners and breakneck pace creates chaos in the final furlong, with a hold-up horse finding clear running when others have shot their bolt. This requires perfect timing and significant class.

races.paceDynamic: Eachtotheirown will lead uncontested with no other confirmed front runners in this nine-runner field. The confirmed leader should set a comfortable, sustainable gallop with prominent runners Skylight Hustle, Free Spirit and Too Bossy For Us tracking within striking distance. The hold-up brigade of El Cairos, Sober, Blake, Koktail Brut and Le Labo will need to find gaps and rely on late finishing kicks from off the pace. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and prominent/hold-up horses with proven finishing ability, as the lack of early pace pressure will create a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can position perfectly behind Eachtotheirown's steady gallop
scenarios.body: Skylight Hustle or Too Bossy For Us can time their challenge to perfection as the hold-up horses get caught too far back. The lack of early pace suits horses that can track and pounce rather than those needing maximum tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field stays tightly bunched throughout
scenarios.body: El Cairos, Sober or Blake can unleash devastating late runs as superior class tells in a sprint finish. The tactical race becomes a pure test of finishing speed where ratings and recent form matter most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Eachtotheirown gets an easy lead and the field fails to close the gap in time
scenarios.body: The leader's 2W4P record on similar going suggests he can sustain his effort when not pressured early. His recent Gowran win shows he has the engine to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Eachtotheirown sets pedestrian fractions and the race becomes a pure sprint
scenarios.body: The race turns into a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Form horses like Koktail Brut or Blake could emerge from the pack in a blanket finish.

The sustained pace will stretch the field early, creating gaps and putting pressure on the hold-up horses to get into the race before it's too late. This honest tempo clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure hold-up merchants who need a slow pace to be effective.

scenarios.body: A more sedate middle section allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and mount their challenges. July Flower and Western Fold can use their finishing kicks more effectively in this tactical scenario.

scenarios.title: Kitzbuhel Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Kitzbuhel dictates on the front end and maintains his relentless gallop without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The Mullins star uses his class advantage to control proceedings and prove too strong in the closing stages. His front-running style combined with superior ability makes him hard to peg back when in this mood.

scenarios.body: The early pace war sets up a tactical finish where late closers can sweep past the exhausted leaders. Hold-up horses who were detached early suddenly find themselves perfectly positioned for the finale.
